chunks: Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"Consuming al-ushnan melts the body, rubbing oneself with pottery wears out the body, and using the siwak in the toilet causes bad breath."

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: tooth-stick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.الْأُشْنَانِ: a cleansing substance or herb mentioned here as harmful when consumed
key_terms.الْبَخَرَ: bad breath or offensive odor from the mouth
key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: the toilet or place of relief
key_terms.يُذِيبُ: causes to waste away or melt

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام say about eating al-ushnan and using siwak in the toilet?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام mentions certain bodily habits and their harmful effects. It warns against eating al-ushnan, rubbing with pottery, and using the siwak in the toilet, presenting them as practices that harm the body or cause offensive breath.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.110 - Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"Consuming ushnan (a type of cleansing herb) melts the body, scrubbing with pottery wears out the body, and using a siwak in the bathroom causes bad breath”.
